exceptions.name: Stripe.net
exceptions.reason: Official Stripe .NET SDK. Nuspec ships license type=file (LICENSE in the nupkg) without an SPDX expression; reviewed as Apache-2.0.

exceptions.name: xunit.abstractions
exceptions.reason: Transitive xUnit abstractions package only publishes a licenseUrl to the Apache-2.0 text; no SPDX expression in the nuspec.

Optional platform binaries for sharp (Next.js image pipeline). Registry under-reports LGPL-3.0-or-later vs distributed package manifests; overrideDetectedLicense applies the reviewed combined license on every OS.
Optional libvips native binaries pulled by sharp; overrideDetectedLicense keeps LGPL-3.0-or-later canonical across platforms when registry metadata differs.

exceptions.name: minimatch
exceptions.reason: Permissive BlueOak-1.0.0 transitive dependency; not on the default allowlist, reviewed and accepted.

exceptions.name: caniuse-lite
exceptions.reason: Browserslist dataset under CC-BY-4.0; attribution retained via generated notices.

exceptions.name: language-subtag-registry
exceptions.reason: Public-domain equivalent language subtag data (CC0-1.0); accepted for tooling use.

exceptions.name: axe-core
exceptions.reason: Transitive accessibility engine under MPL-2.0; retained with notices, no replacement planned.

exceptions.name: lightningcss
exceptions.reason: CSS transformer used by Tailwind/Next tooling under MPL-2.0; retained with notices.
Optional platform binaries for lightningcss under MPL-2.0; retained with notices.
